# @clegra/sdk

> Clegra apps: a web app with a plain MCP server (revision 2026-07-28, the official @modelcontextprotocol/server underneath) plus small extensions: com.clegra/web-map (records as resources at their web URLs, tools that name their page, the per-person webmap://pages resource, badges and widgets), com.clegra/app-share (share targets and plugins), and profiles for session transfer, access scopes, app agents as skills, the app's own confirmation of irreversible calls, and two event types. Agents use MCP tools; pages are for people; one OAuth login on the app's own page.

## Docs

- [Reference](spec.md): definitions, what they become on the wire, serve and its routes, confirmation, session transfer, events, access log, adapters, testing, the check CLI
- [AI guide](ai-guide.md): the single-file reference for coding agents
- [Getting started: plain JavaScript](start-javascript.md)
- [Getting started: Next.js](start-next.md)
- [Sign-in](auth.md): the sign-in module, devSignIn, passwordLogin, or your own authorization server
- [Extensions index](extensions/README.md): the normative documents and the adoption levels A, B1, B2, C
